name: Spells Enhanced
summary:
This mod adds 20 brand-new spells to Hogwarts Legacy, expanding your magical toolkit with a mix of offensive, defensive, utility, and enemy exclusive abilities. From channeling AoE spells and elemental attacks to teleportation, healing, and crowd control, each spell is carefully crafted to feel lore friendly and blend naturally with the game's combat and casting system for a seamless experience.

Spells can also be enhanced through talent upgrades, transforming their visuals, behavior, and overall power to better suit your combat style. If you are using multiple mods with talents, use the mod "TALENT UI FIX". For the talents to take effect, fast travel or save and load the game.

Spells are locked behind specific quests to maintain balance and immersion. You will unlock them naturally as you progress through the game. Alternatively, for those who want instant access, you can open the built-in widget by pressing "F6". There, you can unlock spells manually and view information about which quest unlocks each one.
